name: nfip-la
title: Louisiana flood insurance claims and policies
summary: Work with FEMA's public flood insurance data for Louisiana: claims by storm and flood zone, compliance payments, policies in force, repetitive loss and mitigation, community status and homes insured.
description: Each task gives the AI extracts of FEMA's public flood insurance data for Louisiana, with FEMA's own field dictionary. The question states its facts, such as a parish, a year, a date or a definition, and asks for exact figures: counts, totals, shares, medians and the codes behind them. Every question covers a group of at least ten rows, never a single claim or policy. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

upstream.name: OpenFEMA, National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) data

families.name: Reading FEMA's codes
families.what: FEMA's codes read with its dictionary: cause of damage, reasons for no payment, deductibles, occupancy and settlement basis.

families.name: Claim counts and payments
families.what: Claim counts, insured units and net payments for a year of loss or a group of flood zones, with levee-protected zones kept apart.

families.name: Claim payments
families.what: Building, contents and compliance payments kept apart and set against damage, value and coverage.

families.name: Claim timing
families.what: The days between the loss and the opening of the claim, and between the loss and the last payment after one hurricane, as medians and shares.

families.name: Storm events
families.what: How claims spread across FEMA's flood event tags, with named storms read against untagged claims, general tags and dates of loss.

families.name: Increased cost of compliance
families.what: Compliance claims statewide: totals, payments against each claim's own limit, by parish and by storm.

families.name: Policies on the books
families.what: Policies in force on a date, cancellations, premium and policy cost by flood zone, building age and occupancy.

families.name: Policy coverage
families.what: Coverage against replacement cost, cost per $1,000 of coverage by deductible, and premium against full-risk premium.

families.name: Loss ratio
families.what: A loss ratio, defined in the question, from the claims and policies of one parish and year.

families.name: Parish totals combined
families.what: Figures from different FEMA files combined at parish level, never row by row.

families.name: Repetitive loss
families.what: Properties with repeated flood losses, and severe ones, by category, by parish and by number of losses.

families.name: Mitigation
families.what: Which repetitive loss properties have been mitigated, flags reset by mitigation, and each parish's mitigation rate.

families.name: Community status
families.what: Which communities take part in the program, the history of sanctions, map dates read with their codes, and community ratings.

families.name: Share of homes insured
families.what: Residential penetration rates statewide, inside the high-risk flood zone, and by parish.

families.name: Checking the rows
families.what: Rows that contradict their own fields or FEMA's definitions, counted. Some checks rightly find none.
